headline: EPS climbs while cash reserves shrink sharply
summary_short: Synchrony reported Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $2.59, up 14.1% q/q and 3.6% y/y, on revenue of $3.72B (+0.5% q/q, +1.9% y/y). Net income was $885M (+9.9% q/q, -8.5% y/y) and cash and equivalents fell to $16.19B (-21.2% q/q, -16.8% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue was $3.72B, up 0.5% q/q and 1.9% y/y. Diluted EPS was $2.59, up 14.1% q/q and 3.6% y/y; basic EPS was $2.61, up 14.0% q/q and 4.0% y/y. Net income was $885M, up 9.9% q/q but down 8.5% y/y from $967M. Pretax income was $1.19B, up 13.3% q/q and down 5.6% y/y. Cash and cash equivalents fell to $16.19B, down 21.2% q/q and 16.8% y/y from $19.46B. Weighted average diluted shares outstanding were 334.1M, down 3.4% q/q and 11.9% y/y. No margin figure is available on the verified shard for this period.
